verdicts.reason: A keeps a sensible top-to-bottom order (illustration, headline, dates), but the two dates are stacked at different sizes (March 6 smaller than March 1), the connector line has become a heavy bar stranded near the bottom edge, and the illustration is shrunk, leaving a large dead band between the dates and the bar. B's big headline is strong, but the date range falls apart: 'March 6' is tiny and sits on top of the tooth graphic, 'March 1' floats on the right with nothing next to it, and the line is orphaned in the bottom-right corner, so the dates read out of order and the event dates are hard to read.
